title: nogat-server/1
description: What a server serves, at `GET /api/v1/server` of a tool's own server and of Latarnik alike, so that a client needs one address and one request (AGI-6.7; S4 of docs/plans/2026-11-24-qgis-plugin.md and of docs/plans/2026-11-24-latarnik.md, ECO-094, ECO-095): one entry in `services` on a tool's own server, one per routed service and one for Latarnik itself on Latarnik, which builds each routed entry from the tool's own with `api` mapped to `/<tool>/v<major>` and refreshes it every minute. A client uses the services whose `tool` it knows and an `api` major it speaks, skips the rest and refuses a known service with no such major, naming both versions; a capability absent from `capabilities` is not served. Projects copy this file like schemas/agent/ (ECO-050). Unknown fields are allowed: adding optional fields keeps the version (AGI-4.1).

release_set.description: Latarnik only: the release set its services were verified as (REL §6), e.g. `v0.3.0`

flows.description: Latarnik only: the names of the flows that `GET /api/v1/flows` describes

reference.description: A URL reference: relative to the document's own address for a service on the same host, absolute for one on another host

tool.description: The project in lower case as `<project>` of the standard, `latarnik` for Latarnik's own entry

version.description: The version of the service's package, as its `/health` reports it

api.description: Each served major of the API and its base: `{"1": "/api/v1"}` on a tool's own server, `{"1": "/obserwator/v1"}` behind Latarnik; a new major is listed beside the old one while both are served

capabilities.description: What the service serves, in the tool's own words (Obserwator: `stations`, `current`, `series`, `hec-table`, `hec-dss`, `analyses`; Kartograf: `catalog`, its command catalog and the queries without paths, `plan`, the plans of its data commands, `script`, `script generate`), each only when served; a client hides what is absent

ogcapi.description: The landing page of the service's OGC API – Features, where it serves one

gui.description: The address of the service's GUI, from `[nogat.gui]` of `nogat.toml` (DEV-15.4, DEV-18.1), where it has one

instance.description: The deployment as its operator describes it (Obserwator's `[obserwator.instance]`): the title shown to a person and the featured provider

terms.description: The regulamin the service serves (DEV-15.7) and its version (REL-1.4), which a client confirms once per server and version before any data request; absent where it serves none

attribution.description: The attribution lines of the providers the service serves (DEV-20.6), in the order of DEV-20.4

terms_notice.description: The terms lines of those providers (DEV-20.7)

state.description: Latarnik only, on each routed entry: `ok`; `other_version`, routed but used by no flow; `unreachable`, the last refresh did not reach it and its routes answer `source_unavailable`
